observations.text: Official manual: PRC-28 contains exactly four ordered transitions, stages 1 through 4; each stage output becomes the next stage input.
In PRC-28 stage 1, VOR-22 changes into VOR-77.
In PRC-28 stage 2, VOR-77 changes into PEL-38.
In PRC-28 stage 4, HAP-43 changes into terminal marker VOR-83.

In PRC-24 stage 4, ZIR-76 changes into terminal marker XAN-16.

In PRC-84 stage 2, BEX-79 changes into XAN-60.
In PRC-84 stage 4, KEL-52 changes into terminal marker ZIR-92.
